{{Quote|I saw that guy take out three fully armed and armored rebel commandos by himself, with nothing but his hands.|[[Eyan McDermitt]], to a spy|<ref name="SWG:CE" />}}
'''Jubai Laetlii''' was a [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Commando/Legends|commando]] who lived during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]]. After the [[Battle of Yavin/Legends|Battle of Yavin]], Laetlii was stationed at the [[Imperial Oasis]], on the planet [[Tatooine/Legends|Tatooine]].<ref name="SWG:CE" /> In [[1 ABY/Legends|1 ABY]],<ref name="SWG_timeline">{{SWG_timeline}}</ref> Jubai Laetlii bought a [[Datapad/Legends|datapad]] with sensitive information stolen from the [[Incom Corporation/Legends|Incom Corporation]] to the [[Pirate/Legends|pirate]] [[Eyan McDermitt]]. However, a [[Spy/Legends|spy]] working for [[Sarlis Beni]] also tried to recover the datapad and traced Jubai Laetlii to the Imperial Oasis. The spy just planned to steal the datapad instead of trying to confront Laetlii directly, and finally succeeded in robing the datapad from Jubai unnoticed.<ref name="SWG:CE" />

==Behind the scenes==
Jubai Laetlii was a [[Wikipedia:Non-player character|non-player character]] in the [[2003]] [[Star Wars video games|video game]] ''[[Star Wars Galaxies]]'', a [[Wikipedia:Massively multiplayer online role-playing game|massively multiplayer online roleplaying game]] developed by [[Sony]] Online Entertainment and published by [[LucasArts]],<ref name="SWG:CE" /> prior to its closure on [[December 15]], [[2011]].<ref name="Shutdown">{{SonyCite|url=playerinfo|text=IMPORTANT INFORMATION ABOUT ''STAR WARS'' GALAXIES™}}</ref> Jubai Laetlii was added to the game upon the release of the "[[W:c:swg:Publish 25 Notes for November 15, 2005|Publish 25]]", a.k.a. the "[[W:c:swg:New Game Enhancements|New Game Enhancements]]," on [[November 15]], [[2005]].<ref name="SonyCite-Publish Archive 2005">{{SonyCite|url=players/content.vm?id=64886&resource=publish|text=Publish Archive 2005}}</ref>

In the game, players could choose to kill Jubai to retrieve the datapad, or steal it from him peacefully. This article assume that Jubai was not killed, as it was the recommended course of action in the game.<ref name="SWG:CE" />
